overloadMerges.note: The doc syntax line has no parenthesized parameter list ('Self : Pointer'), so the mechanical parser produced an empty overload with no return type at all; restored the documented Pointer return type.
overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns a pointer to the object whose object method is currently being executed, or a Nil pointer (->[]) if called out of context.

constraints: Returns a valid pointer only when called from within an object method, or from a project method called directly/indirectly by an object method; otherwise returns a Nil pointer (->[]).
In the context of a list box, returns a pointer to the list box or to a column of the list box depending on the calling context.
